verdict.rationale: Claude Code is fundamentally driven by natural-language instructions in the terminal, IDE, Slack, or web—users describe intent in plain language and it plans, writes code, runs tests, opens PRs, etc. This is corroborated by extensive first-party docs and independent hands-on community usage confirming it operates via conversational commands (with mixed quality opinions, but not disputing the natural-language interaction model itself). Missing for 10: deeper independent benchmarking specifically on natural-language command fidelity/robustness beyond anecdotal community reports.
